files.tests/test_color.py:
import pytest
from gpio_service.common.color import Color


def test_bare_hex_non_default():
    c = Color.fromHex("ff0000")
    assert c.r == 255
    assert c.g == 0
    assert c.b == 0


def test_hash_prefixed_non_default():
    c = Color.fromHex("#00ff00")
    assert c.r == 0
    assert c.g == 255
    assert c.b == 0


def test_mixed_case_hex():
    c = Color.fromHex("#AbCdEf")
    assert c.r == 0xAB
    assert c.g == 0xCD
    assert c.b == 0xEF


def test_whitespace_around_hex():
    c = Color.fromHex("  #123456  ")
    assert c.r == 0x12
    assert c.g == 0x34
    assert c.b == 0x56


def test_malformed_length_returns_fallback():
    c = Color.fromHex("#12345")
    assert c.r == 255
    assert c.g == 255
    assert c.b == 255


def test_trailing_data_returns_fallback():
    c = Color.fromHex("#1234567")
    assert c.r == 255
    assert c.g == 255
    assert c.b == 255


def test_invalid_characters_returns_fallback():
    c = Color.fromHex("#12345G")
    assert c.r == 255
    assert c.g == 255
    assert c.b == 255


def test_non_string_returns_fallback():
    c = Color.fromHex(12345)
    assert c.r == 255
    assert c.g == 255
    assert c.b == 255


def test_fallback_is_fresh_object():
    c1 = Color.fromHex(12345)
    c2 = Color.fromHex(12345)
    assert c1 is not c2
    assert c1.r == 255
    assert c2.r == 255


def test_existing_channel_order():
    c = Color(10, 20, 30)
    assert c.r == 10
    assert c.g == 20
    assert c.b == 30
    assert c.toRGB() == (30, 10, 20)


def test_generate_random_returns_color():
    c = Color.generateRandom()
    assert isinstance(c, Color)
    assert 0 <= c.r <= 255
    assert 0 <= c.g <= 255
    assert 0 <= c.b <= 255
